name: Exiled Sector Skill Tree
desc: Internal marker hullmod used by Exiled Sector to apply per-ship skill tree effects. Always installed automatically; not player-visible.

name: Exiled Sector Conflict Warning
desc: Internal marker hullmod used by Exiled Sector to explain a hullmod removed due to a conflicting allocated passive. Always installed automatically; not player-visible.

name: Exiled Sector OP Reserve
desc: Internal marker hullmod used by Exiled Sector to reserve ordnance points spent on purchased passive points. Its OP cost is set programmatically per ship. Always installed automatically; not player-visible.
